work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXXVI lets the Savona confraternity of the two Saints John wear a red cord with the white habit; LF39029 → LF39042 across own provenance LF39032, signature LF39033, sheet number 34 LF39036 and page number 266 LF39039; complete 26 June 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF38983–38983; the source closing at LF39061–39064 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima sexta iunii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
